zh.title: 四起獨立航空事件彙整：休士頓、航途中與伯明罕
zh.summary: 四起獨立航空事件涉及煞車、起落架、行動電源與跑道偏出
body: 以下彙整四起彼此獨立的航空事件，沒有資料指出事件之間有關聯。
Mesa E175於2026年10月26日在休士頓發生煞車與轉向問題。
United波音737 MAX 9（ICAO機型代碼B39M）於2026年10月25日在休士頓出現起落架不安全狀況。
Hong Kong A21N（空中巴士A321neo，ICAO機型代碼A21N）於2026年10月25日在航途中發生行動電源熱失控。
Jet2波音737-800（ICAO機型代碼B738）於2026年10月25日在伯明罕發生短暫跑道偏出。

en.title: Roundup: four independent aviation incidents reported in Houston, en route and Birmingham
en.summary: Four separate aviation incidents were reported: brake issues, unsafe gear, power bank thermal runaway and runway excursion.
body: This briefing covers four separate aviation incidents, with no stated relationship among them. The incidents are dated October 25 and 26, 2026.
A Mesa E175 had brake and steering problems in Houston on October 26, 2026.
A United Boeing 737 MAX 9 (ICAO type code B39M) was reported with unsafe gear in Houston on October 25, 2026.
A Hong Kong A21N, an Airbus A321neo (ICAO type code A21N), was reported with a power bank thermal runaway en route on October 25, 2026.
A Jet2 Boeing 737-800 (ICAO type code B738) had a temporary runway excursion at Birmingham on October 25, 2026.
